title: Clean Energy Finance Corporation Amendment (Protecting Australian Farmland) Bill 2026
short_title: Clean Energy Finance Corporation Amendment (Protecting Australian Farmland) Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prevent the Clean Energy Finance Corporation from funding farmland purchases where the land would mainly generate carbon credits through regeneration or forestry.
It would add a prohibited farm investment category and definitions covering Australian farmland, carbon credit units and farm enterprises to the corporation's governing legislation.
The new restriction would apply whenever the corporation performs its investment function from commencement onwards, covering farmland purchases mainly intended for those carbon credit activities.
changes: Purchases mainly intended for carbon credit generation through land regeneration would become prohibited investments.
The legislation would define Australian farmland and farm enterprises for the new investment restriction.
A statutory definition of carbon credit unit would be added.
summary.affected: The Clean Energy Finance Corporation and businesses seeking its funding for farmland purchases for carbon credit projects are affected.
